audience: fundraisers at charities and nonprofits who keep supporters and donations in Beacon CRM

useCases.title: Find supporters or payments that match conditions
useCases.text: The AI reads the record types and fields, then filters records with conditions on field values, for example people whose email contains a domain.

useCases.title: Read a person, organisation or payment record
useCases.text: The AI lists records of one type page by page and opens one with all its fields, so you can review a supporter's data.

useCases.title: Add or update records, matching by a key field
useCases.text: The AI creates a record, changes fields of an existing record, or finds a match by a key field such as email or external id and updates it, to avoid duplicates.

useCases.title: Delete a record
useCases.text: The AI finds a record and deletes it. Beacon keeps it as archived, but this server cannot restore it.

useCases.title: Run an export and get its download link
useCases.text: The AI starts an export from an existing export template and checks its progress until it is complete and has a download link.
